entities.name: Thomas Hill Williams
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas Hill Williams was a United States Senator from Mississippi, one of the first two senators from that state. He served two terms of office, from 1817 to 1829, retiring to Tennessee after his retirement from politics.
